1.Name: HORUS - screen (read watchlist, write screenings)
1.Comment: The role the screening path uses. Cannot read audit_event; cannot UPDATE or DELETE anything.

2.Name: HORUS - audit (append-only evidence)
2.Comment: INSERT and SELECT on audit_event and nothing else. Try an UPDATE: it must fail.

3.Name: HORUS - ingest (writes watchlist and config)
3.Comment: Writes watchlist tables and config_version. Cannot read screening_* tables.

4.Name: HORUS - admin (owner; full access - use sparingly)
4.Comment: Owns the schema and runs migrations. Use it to see everything or to draw the ERD.
